one_line: Rebuilding a run skips the check that the Jenkinsfile script is still approved, so an Item/Build user runs code whose approval was revoked.
Restarting a build from a stage skips the same approval re-check, so an Item/Build user runs code whose approval was revoked.
Folder-scoped library overrides run outside the Script Security sandbox, so an Item/Configure user runs unsandboxed code.
A low-privilege user can create documents via creation endpoints that do not check authorization, bypassing the role model.
An unauthenticated attacker reaches restricted resources by requesting their URLs directly, bypassing authentication.
A crafted empty requirePasswordChange parameter bypasses authentication and exposes protected functionality.
Improper authorization allows a user to perform operations beyond the rights granted to that user.
A recipient with the assistant role completes another signer's signature field because the signing handler checks neither field type nor ownership, forging that signer's signature.
A user with Asset Materialize permission can trigger DAGs outside the permission scope granted to that user.
An authorization flaw lets a user access a workflow resource beyond the permission granted to that user.
With --auth-mode=client, API requests can bypass authentication, letting a client act on workflows without authenticating.
